title: Normalized cartesian comparisons for affine étale pullbacks
statement: Let I be any preorder in universe u and D : I^op → Scheme.{u} a diagram of schemes [def-pc-scheme] whose transition morphisms are affine [pqf-def-affine-morphism]. Let c be a cone: a scheme c.pt and maps c_i : c.pt → D_i with c_j followed by D_ji equal to c_i for i ≤ j. Assume every c_i is affine. No directedness, nonemptiness, quasi-compactness, quasi-separatedness, or universal property of c is required. Write C_i and C for the full affine étale categories of D_i and c.pt [def-weil-pbc-full-affine-etale-site]. There exist functors U_ij : C_i → C_j for i ≤ j and v_i : C_i → C, natural first projections p_ij and q_i on underlying schemes, and natural isomorphisms gamma_ijk : U_ij U_jk ≅ U_ik and delta_ij : U_ij v_j ≅ v_i, with the following properties. U_ii is the identity. For every A → D_i, the squares with top arrows p_ij(A) : U_ij(A) → A and q_i(A) : v_i(A) → A, vertical structure maps, and bottom arrows D_ji and c_i respectively are pullbacks [def-pc-fibre-product]. Gamma_iik and gamma_ikk are heterogeneously equal to the identity isomorphism of U_ik, and delta_ii is heterogeneously equal to the identity of v_i. The comparison first projections satisfy gamma_ijk(A).left followed by p_ik(A) = p_jk(U_ij(A)) followed by p_ij(A), and delta_ij(A).left followed by q_i(A) = q_j(U_ij(A)) followed by p_ij(A). There is no cocycle, covering, pullback-preservation, or continuity conclusion.

source.place: 0EYL (lemma-colimit-affine-sites), base-change system and the coherence discussion following its proof; parent geometric construction steps 1-3. Source read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0EYL.

proof.text: Construct normalizedPullback by ObjectProperty.lift of ordinary étale pullback through the full affine inclusion. Affineness is proved by instIsAffinePullbackSchemeOfIsAffineHom_1, with the original affine object property. Its natural first projection is pullback.fst, and naturality is pullback.lift_fst. The object square is IsPullback.of_hasPullback.

For each transition, normalizedPair constructs both the functor and projection together. If i = j, use the identity functor, the underlying-scheme functor left unitor as projection, and IsPullback.id_horiz after D.map_id. Its component projection is identity. Otherwise use normalizedPullback and normalizedFirst. Assemble these explicitly proved witnesses with choose; no data is chosen from an unproved existence statement. Construct v and q directly as normalizedPullback and normalizedFirst along the affine cone projections.

Apply the normalized cartesian comparison theorem to these actual functors and projections, supplying normalizedPair identity and projection normalizations, its cartesian squares, and normalizedSquare for the cone projections. Assemble the required eight clauses. Cocycle and site clauses remain proved in the parent module.

proof_origin.place: Lean construction of the restricted pullback functors, diagonal identity choices, natural projections, and cartesian squares underlying 0EYL. Only the normalized comparison theorem is imported as an open step. R3, 2026-10-12.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_affineEtale_normalized_cartesian_system
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I]
    (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    (c : Cone D) [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, IsAffineHom (c.π.app i)] :
    ∃ (U : ∀ (i j : I), i ≤ j → (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale ⥤
          (D.obj (op j)).FullAffineEtale)
      (v : ∀ i : I, (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale ⥤ c.pt.FullAffineEtale)
      (p : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j),
        U i j h ⋙ fullAffineEtaleInclusion (D.obj (op j)) ⋙
          Etale.forget (D.obj (op j)) ⋙ Over.forget (D.obj (op j)) ⟶
        fullAffineEtaleInclusion (D.obj (op i)) ⋙
          Etale.forget (D.obj (op i)) ⋙ Over.forget (D.obj (op i)))
      (q : ∀ i : I,
        v i ⋙ fullAffineEtaleInclusion c.pt ⋙ Etale.forget c.pt ⋙ Over.forget c.pt ⟶
        fullAffineEtaleInclusion (D.obj (op i)) ⋙
          Etale.forget (D.obj (op i)) ⋙ Over.forget (D.obj (op i)))
      (gamma : ∀ (i j k : I) (h : i ≤ j) (h' : j ≤ k),
        U i j h ⋙ U j k h' ≅ U i k (h.trans h'))
      (delta : ∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j), U i j h ⋙ v j ≅ v i),
      (∀ i : I, U i i le_rfl = 𝟭 _)
      ∧ (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
        IsPullback ((p i j h).app A) ((U i j h).obj A).obj.hom
          A.obj.hom (D.map (homOfLE h).op))
      ∧ (∀ (i : I) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
        IsPullback ((q i).app A) ((v i).obj A).obj.hom A.obj.hom (c.π.app (op i)))
      ∧ (∀ (i k : I) (h : i ≤ k),
        HEq (gamma i i k le_rfl h) (Iso.refl (U i k h)))
      ∧ (∀ (i k : I) (h : i ≤ k),
        HEq (gamma i k k h le_rfl) (Iso.refl (U i k h)))
      ∧ (∀ i : I, HEq (delta i i le_rfl) (Iso.refl (v i)))
      ∧ (∀ (i j k : I) (h : i ≤ j) (h' : j ≤ k)
        (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
        ((gamma i j k h h').hom.app A).hom.left ≫ (p i k (h.trans h')).app A =
          (p j k h').app ((U i j h).obj A) ≫ (p i j h).app A)
      ∧ (∀ (i j : I) (h : i ≤ j) (A : (D.obj (op i)).FullAffineEtale),
        ((delta i j h).hom.app A).hom.left ≫ (q i).app A =
          (q j).app ((U i j h).obj A) ≫ (p i j h).app A)
